description: Percent-encode text for URLs, exactly like JavaScript encodeURIComponent ("component", default) or encodeURI ("full"). UTF-8 based. Web version: https://s3eidat.github.io/url-toolkit/

mode.description: "component" = encodeURIComponent (for one query value or path segment; escapes / ? & = #). "full" = encodeURI (a whole URL; keeps those).

name: url_encode
title: URL encode
